parrafo_1.es: Handyman & Landscaping and more es el negocio de Juan en Kendall. Se encarga del paisajismo, instalación y restauración de pavimentos, reparación de sistemas de riego y reparaciones generales dentro de la casa.
parrafo_1.en: Handyman & Landscaping and more is Juan's business in Kendall. He takes care of landscaping, paver installs and restorations, irrigation system repair, and general repairs inside the home.

parrafo_2.es: Las reseñas repiten lo mismo: profesional, puntual y minucioso. Regi destaca que Juan restauró sus pavimentos y arregló una bomba de riego que llevaba años sin funcionar.
parrafo_2.en: The reviews keep saying the same thing: professional, punctual and thorough. Regi points out that Juan restored her pavers and fixed an irrigation pump that had not worked in years.

items.quote: Juan is very professional and knowledgable. He restored our pavers and fixed our irrigation system/pump that hasn't been working for many years. Great job, fast, professional, impecable. Highly recommend!

Great experience with Juan from Handyman & Landscaping Service! He did a really good job, was professional, and arrived right on time. I appreciate the quality of the work and his reliability. I would definitely recommend his services to others!
Juan has done a beautiful job on my landscaping and so many other jobs. Ty Juan for your service and dedication to excellence. Loved his work and highly recommend Juan.
Amazing work in our yard! Affordable and quick! Definitely recommending to friends and family and keeping as our go to landscaper.
